warning.titlePre: Jaguar XK 4.2 V8 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ-V8 Gen III is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ-V8 Gen III V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V8 Gen III rebuild.
Because the XK 4.2 V8 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the XK 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ-V8 Gen III specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
